message.clowderhall.book_rules.page_1:
Clowder Rules

1. The Dock is shared.
2. Pads belong to Clowders — claim via Create Team + pad template.
3. Soil first. Stone: 1 Thread → 3 string; 4 string → 2 Void Yarn; then Tension Barrel clay / porcelain / sieve.
4. Frayed Thread buys help, not a skip past the braid.
message.clowderhall.book_rules.page_2:
Strand tribes

Soil — Pad-keepers
Stone — Grit-singers
Sprout — Rootbinders
Claw — Edge-walkers
Spark — Drumhearts
Clock — Pattern-weavers
Swarm — Colony-keepers
Sigil — Seal-carvers
Spindle — Loom-stitchers
message.clowderhall.book_rules.page_3:
How to start (OOC)

1) Right-click Island Charter
   (or press K — Clowder panel)
2) Create Team → type a name
3) Pick a pad template:
   Ninjacat Pad = Normal
   Dojo Cottage = Easy
   Frayed Thread = Hard
4) Whisker Codex — Start here.
   Grave (`): assignment list.

Invite a friend: hold this Charter and
right-click them, or /clowder invite <name>.
They accept with /clowder accept.

Also: /clowder help · /clowder hub · Hub Key.
message.clowderhall.book_rules.page_4:
If you feel lost

• Dock is the hub, not your pad.
• Charter opens Clowders; Create Team picks a pad.
• On your pad: sneak-use Charter seals spawn here.
• /clowder hub is always safe.
• /clowder return leaves the Hall.
• Whisker Codex: Start here first.
  Grave (`): quests.
• How to Start book = plain OOC steps.
message.clowderhall.book_hall.page_1:
Clowder Hall

Teams are Clowders.
Pads are claimed, not owned forever.
The Loom still listens.
message.clowderhall.book_hall.page_2:
Hall rules

1. Share the hub.
2. Claim a pad via Skyblock / Charter.
3. Pull Strands; do not skip Soil.
4. Frayed Thread buys help, not shortcuts past the braid.
message.clowderhall.book_hall.page_3:
Begin

/clowder help
Hub Key toggles the Hall.

Invite a friend: hold the Charter
and right-click them, or
/clowder invite <name>. They run
/clowder accept.

Ops only: /clowder revive.
message.clowderhall.book_start.page_1:
HOW TO START (read me)

You are in Clowder Hall or on Dock — not your forever island.

Goal: open Create Team on the Dock, pick a pad, then open the Whisker Codex.
message.clowderhall.book_start.page_2:
CLAIM A PAD

1) Island Charter (or press K)
2) Create Team → name your Clowder
3) Pick a pad:
   Ninjacat Pad = Normal
   Dojo Cottage = Easy
   Frayed Thread = Hard
4) Whisker Codex — Start here.
   Grave (`): assignment list.

Playing together? See the last page.
message.clowderhall.book_start.page_3:
QUESTS / RECOVER

Easy ships water already.
Normal/Hard: ice + lava + empty bucket.

1) Unravel Thread → 3 string
2) Craft 4 string → 2 Void Yarn
3) Spindle Hammer = cobble + sticks
4) Tension Barrel: water+dirt → clay
   (empty bucket returns to you)
5) Porcelain clay → porcelain bucket
6) Sieve grit; slime = dirt+seeds+meal
message.clowderhall.book_start.page_4:
SOFT HARDCORE

Each mate adds three shared lives:
• Deaths spend a shared life
• /skybound lives checks the pool
• Op: /skybound revive [player]

Hub Key toggles Hall enter/leave.
Sneak-use Charter seals spawn on solid pad ground.
message.clowderhall.book_start.page_5:
PLAY TOGETHER

One Clowder shares one pad, one
quest list and one life pool.

Invite: hold the Charter and
right-click a friend, or
/clowder invite <name>.

They accept with /clowder accept
or the panel's Review Invites.
